morbi.headline: Morbi faces export shocks and rising propane costs despite minor energy price relief.
what_changed: Ceramic exports suffered a Rs 3,589 crore drop over six months due to the war in Iran, though Gulf shipments have recently resumed.
Propane gas prices increased by Rs 3 to Rs 104/kg, while natural gas received a Rs 5 price discount.
Local industry leaders represented power, water, and infrastructure issues to the district minister.
stress_signals: War in Iran caused a Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports over six months [19f71f3185bc].
Industrial propane gas prices rose by Rs 3 per kg to Rs 104/kg [9e8c549b7c05].
Suspicious stock of imported coal discovered inside a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53].
Overall export outlook for the cluster remains weak despite resuming Gulf shipments [c2b4a2f5422a].
improvement_signals: Ceramic industry received a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices, dropping rates from Rs 82 [279312659941].
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park for ₹1.21 crore [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Export shipment volumes and order book recovery following the resumption of Gulf trade routes.
Margin pressures on units heavily reliant on propane gas versus natural gas.
Government response and policy decisions regarding power, water, and infrastructure representations.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe textile liquidity stress and diamond headwinds, balanced by festive demand and policy updates.
what_changed: Surat textile weavers in the Sayan zone plan a collective vacation to cut production by 60 crore meters over 15 days [297b184838d2].
Textile PLI scheme turnover threshold was halved and extended to FY 2033-34 [c7ee55f3effe].
Embroidery workers in Surat ended their labor movement following an agreement with owners [3a495ae0b3ee].
stress_signals: Surat textile trade faces severe payment crises and blockages threatening small traders [e0787797133b].
Outstanding textile payment dues exceeded 200 days, triggering weaver protests ahead of Diwali [774ba602b06e].
Payment disputes between Surat traders and weavers escalated to the police station [80f44f3f370f].
Bhavnagar diamond industry slowdown shut 800 offices and diverted 1 lakh artisans [f374a30b31ac], alongside 100,000 job losses in diamond manufacturing [1bcd949a2599].
improvement_signals: Surat Fanti Satin Sarees gained strong market traction in Karauli markets ahead of Diwali [ee1efdbd9539].
Surat's diamond industry is seeing a resurgence driven by global demand and a pre-Diwali festive boom [01cb30b63e0d].
ICA GemLab launched in Surat for international-grade diamond testing [4b0e420193b2].
what_to_watch: Monitor resolution of payment default crises and stretching receivables beyond 200 days among weavers and traders [774ba602b06e, e0787797133b].
Track execution and uptake of the revised textile PLI scheme following its turnover threshold reduction [c7ee55f3effe].
Watch for potential fresh labor unrest and operational shutdowns following previous agitations [d1fffb80f879].
